2.3.5.6 Although break-up of total vehicles in Government and Private vehicles is not available, it is interesting to note from Table - 8(A) that 96.4 percent victims of 'Truck/Lorry' 59.0 percent of 'Buses', 94.5 percent of 'Tempo/Vans', 85.1% of 'Jeeps' and 94.9 percent of cars involved in accidents were travelling in private vehicles.

2.3.5.7 It is observed that the number of persons dead in Truck/Lorry accidents was high in the States of Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra & Uttar Pradesh being nearly 13% in each State. Similarly, 26.4% of 'Car victims', 17.97% of 'Bus' victims, 16 percent each of 'Bicyclists' and 'Pedestrians' and 12.94% of 'Three wheeler' victims were killed in Tamil Nadu only. 17.2% of 'Jeep' victims & 2.5% of 'Two wheeler' victims were in Maharashtra.
